notes: s015 διανυκτερεύων heads on *night*: the lexeme is unattested, so rule 104 sends the query to the root family, where νυκτ- is *night* throughout, and *continued all* renders the δια- durative. Heading on *continued* remains defensible.
ἦν keeps only the supplied subject *he*, the periphrasis's lexical content being the participle's.
